bio: In this small restaurant, just a few metres from the cathedral, they are fully aware that guests are initially attracted by appearance and that as soon as they walk through the door their appetites will take over! Choose between a huge variety of tapas and raciones (toasted options, sandwiches, high-quality canned ingredients, small plates for sharing etc) that are served at the bar counter or a few high tables. Don’t miss the super-creamy and delicious ham croquettes....
